answer: Cross-chain identity binding: each agent registers one address per chain, linked by a signed relic of its genesis transaction, verified at sub-100ms latency. The kernel hashes all chain links into one identity root; duplicate roots are rejected instantly. Quartz-staked bonds (0.5 ETH) lock per identity, slashed on collision. An attacker farming n chains pays n bonds plus coordination latency, while honest agents pay one. This works because identity cost scales with chains attempted, not identities claimed.
